Bond - affinity: values and public opinion, not kinship.

Not an adversary: Minsk seeks normalisation (Macron call of 24 May 2026, Sakreta's diplomatic contacts), and 52% of Belarusians want it. No source uses 'rival'; our reading (confidence C). The Commission now calls Georgia a candidate 'in name only', has downgraded political contacts, suspended assistance benefiting the authorities and suspended visa-free travel for diplomatic and service passports (6 March 2026). Not 'partner' in the plain sense (the government keeps the stated goal of membership by 2030 while the Commission says the process is at a standstill) and not 'rival' because the EU remains Georgia's institutional shell. No source uses the grade word (C). Bond affinity: the constitutional aim and a pro-European public. Cooling: Hungary, the main shield against EU sanctions, changed government in May 2026.

Full alignment with CFSP and every Russia and Belarus restrictive measure; 61.4% of goods trade is with the EU; EU Reform and Growth Facility in progress. stances_toward.note: Review 2026-10-12: regraded partner - the EU gives candidates no guarantee; ally is reserved for members (Art. 42(7)). Not a treaty ally in the Article 42(7) sense (Montenegro is a candidate), but a stable de facto alignment that the ontology's 'ally' grade covers: 'full and resolute' CFSP alignment praised by the European Parliament on 17 Jun 2026, euro in use since 2002, 18 of 33 chapters provisionally closed by 14 Jul 2026, EU leaders' summit in Tivat on 5 Jun 2026 where von der Leyen called accession 'within reach'. Warming because of the pace of closures and the Growth Plan (EUR 89.3m released by May 2026); the Croatian veto, the Mladic condolences and the UAE procurement exemption are frictions inside the alignment, not changes in structure. Bond - affinity: a stated strategic goal, not kinship.
